contract_caveats.declared_required_paths: task.json declares both organ.nii.gz and lesion.nii.gz under agents_outputs/{case_id}; use both for the submission contract.
contract_caveats.evaluation_metrics: run_eval selects mean lesion Dice for medal tier. aggregate clinical score is 0.5 organ Dice + 0.5 lesion Dice; on incomplete cases aggregate scales clinical metrics by inference completeness before blending workflow and clinical scores.
contract_caveats.formatter_completeness: format_checker.check_submission treats missing mask files as incomplete coverage rather than malformed output and checks organ only if present; this does not supersede task.json all_paths.
contract_caveats.mask_value_rule: format_checker.check_mask_file accepts exact voxel values 0 or 1; dice_scorer.dice_coefficient thresholds at >0.5 after loading. A fractional mask can score internally but fail format validation.
contract_caveats.physical_geometry: Formatter and scorer compare array shape but do not compare affines; physically aligned masks remain the meaningful target.
